validity.researcher_notes: GEM's cited ref (http://fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/zfxxgkzl/wjzx/xmpf/xiangmuhezhunpifu/t2198308.shtml) is on the gxzf.gov.cn domain family, which is unreachable from this environment (ConnectTimeout via url_verifier, ECONNREFUSED via WebFetch/curl on multiple attempts and both http/https) -- could not directly re-verify it live. However, targeted Chinese-language search surfaced independent, non-GEM evidence that the underlying project is real and that GEM's own figures trace to genuine government documents: (1) a Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources land-use pre-review titled '广西壮族自治区自然资源厅关于广西天然气支线管网项目合山天然气支线管道工程建设用地预审的批复' (land-use pre-review for the 'Heshan natural gas branch pipeline engineering' under the Guangxi natural gas branch network project), doc no. 桂自然资预审〔2019〕49号, dated 2019-07-24, at dnr.gxzf.gov.cn/sjcx/jsydys/t16421841.shtml; (2) a Guangxi Development and Reform Commission core-approval titled '广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于广西天然气支线管网项目合山天然气支线管道工程核准的批复' at fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t10409864.shtml, whose associated docx mirror (W020200317745138153919.docx, dated 2019-09-27 per search snippet) states '本项目总投资12802万元' -- i.e. total project investment 128.02 million yuan -- an EXACT match to GEM's SegmentCost=128,020,000 RMB, and the date (2019-09-27) matches GEM's ProposalYear/ProposalMonth=2019-09 almost to the day. This is strong independent corroboration that the pipeline is real (not a GEM-only entity) and that the cost/date fields are correctly sourced. I could NOT independently confirm length (33 km), diameter (DN250/250mm), capacity (0.11 bcm/y) or pressure (4.0 MPa) -- no accessible mirror displayed those specific figures; they are unconfirmed, not contradicted. For context (not cited as evidence for this row): a sibling branch of the same parent project ('广西天然气支线管网项目', built by 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 / Guangxi Gas Group) -- the Qianjiang (迁江) branch -- was core-approved 2025-09-25 and received EIA approval 2025-11-04 (来环审〔2025〕125号) per a page verified live at stj.laibin.gov.cn/xxgk/fdzdgknr/xzxkyxzcfsgs1/xzxk1/t27093542.shtml, which is addressed to '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' -- the exact same operator company GEM records for this row -- confirming that company operates branch pipelines under this program, though that specific document does not name the Heshan branch. Checked the 43-row roster for duplicate/relabel risk: no other PID matches this Xingbin->Heshan routing. P7690 (Xingbin->?, 250mm dia, 64 km, construction) shares the same diameter but differs in length, capacity and status; given the parent project is a genuine fan-out network with many named branch sections (Qianjiang, Wuxuan, Sanjiangkou, Heshan, etc. all independently confirmed to exist as separate government filings), this reads as a distinct branch rather than a double-count of the same physical pipe. Classification (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission) is consistent with the network's other branches and the recorded 4.0 MPa design pressure; no reclassification indicated.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest independently-dated evidence found for this specific branch is its 2019-09-27 core approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864 / associated docx, cost figure matches GEM exactly) plus a 2019-07-24 land-use pre-review (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841) -- both from 2019, none reachable live from this sandbox but both corroborated via independent search-engine-cached document titles/snippets. Ran multiple targeted Chinese-language searches (project name + 'EIA'/环评, + 2024/2025/2026, + construction/施工/核准) looking for any post-2019 activity specific to the Heshan/合山 branch and found none. This is a meaningful contrast: two OTHER branches of the exact same parent program ('广西天然气支线管网项目', operator 广西广投天然气管网有限公司/Guangxi Gas Group) show live, recent progress -- the Qianjiang (迁江) branch was core-approved 2025-09-25 and got EIA sign-off 2025-11-04 (verified live), and the Wuxuan (武宣) branch has a 2026-05 EIA report circulating on document-sharing sites -- so the program overall is active, but the Heshan sub-branch specifically shows no comparable movement since its 2019 approval. Applying the dormancy rule: proposed since 2019-09 with no progress for ~7 years is well past the 2-year proposed->shelved threshold. Proposing shelved with ShelvedCancelledType=Presumed and no fabricated ref, per standing rule. Do not treat as 'cancelled' outright since the branch was never itself recorded as shelved; a future review should re-check after this update lands.
